title: Create documentation and setup guide
description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- README.md in amplify/seed/ with complete usage instructions
- Secret setup documentation (PROD_API_URL, PROD_API_KEY, PROD_ACCOUNT_ID, etc.)
- IAM policy generation instructions
- Troubleshooting guide
- Performance estimates and cost breakdown

## Implementation Steps
- Document installation: npm install @aws-amplify/seed --save-dev
- Document secret setup: npx ampx sandbox secret set commands
- Document IAM policy: npx ampx sandbox seed generate-policy
- Document execution: npx ampx sandbox seed
- Add examples for optional S3 sync
- Include verification checklist

comments.author: derek.norrbom
